core_categories: Complex Rehab Technology; Wheelchairs; Medical Supplies; Assistive Devices; Mobility Equipment
specialty_focus: Numotion is the largest U.S. provider of Complex Rehab Technology (CRT), specializing in individually configured power and manual wheelchairs, medical supplies, and assistive devices. It serves people with disabilities, clinicians, health plans, and workers' compensation carriers, offering prescription-based mobility solutions and direct-to-consumer sales through its SpinLife online retail arm. The company distributes wearable medical devices such as wheelchair blind spot sensors and advanced wheelchair controls.
key_brands: SoftWheel, Braze Mobility, NOW Technologies, others
